description: This file contains JavaScript functions for dynamic UI components such as cards, tables, maps, and modals in a web application. It includes setup for table sorting/searching, map initialization with Leaflet, modal handling, and script loading.

methods.name: sqlpage_card
methods.description: Loads content into card elements and dispatches a fragment-loaded event.

methods.name: setup_table
methods.description: Initializes table sorting, searching, and number formatting within a root element.

methods.name: setup_table_search_behavior
methods.description: Sets up search input to filter table rows based on input text.

methods.name: apply_number_formatting
methods.description: Formats number and currency cells in a table according to specified locale and formatting options.

methods.name: table_parse_data
methods.description: Parses table rows to extract sorting keys based on column types.

methods.name: setup_sort_behavior
methods.description: Adds click event handlers to sort buttons to sort table rows.

methods.name: sqlpage_table
methods.description: Initializes all tables marked with data-pre-init=table.

methods.name: sqlpage_map
methods.description: Initializes map components with Leaflet, adding markers and setting view.

methods.name: addMarker
methods.description: Creates and adds a marker to a Leaflet map, with optional popup or link.

methods.name: createMarker
methods.description: Creates a Leaflet marker with a custom icon.

methods.name: createGeoJSONMarker
methods.description: Creates a Leaflet geoJSON marker with styling.

methods.name: sqlpage_form
methods.description: Sets up file input validation and auto-submit behavior for forms.

methods.name: load_scripts
methods.description: Dynamically loads external scripts specified by data-sqlpage-js attributes.

methods.name: add_init_fn
methods.description: Registers functions to run on DOMContentLoaded and fragment-loaded events.

methods.name: init_bootstrap_components
methods.description: Initializes Bootstrap components like tooltip, popover, dropdown, and carousel.

methods.name: open_modal_for_hash
methods.description: Opens a modal dialog based on URL hash.

methods.name: get_tabler_color
methods.description: Retrieves CSS variable for tabler color themes.
